**Paper Lil Nouniverse** is a vibrant, handcrafted **stop motion animation loops** made entirely with papercuts. 

I’ll produce 3-5 animated loops starring Lil Nouns in surreal, funny, unexpected adventures :fighting monsters, riding paper waves, or launching a DIY spaceship out of cardboard.

**Shareability** in different social media web2 and web3

**Behind-the-scenes engagement**: Showing the handmade process creates an emotional connection, inviting the community to appreciate the patience and creativity behind the meme, strengthening Lil Nouns’ brand value

**Versatility**: The content can be adapted into posters, zines, stickers, and animated NFTs, expanding Lil Nouns’ presence across different cultural formats and spaces.

**Why It’s Nounish**

Stop motion, at its heart, is deeply Nounish: Original, rebellious, and slow in the best way. In a hyper-digital world, it breaks the rules—embracing patience, craft, and imperfection. It reflects what makes Nouns special: the radical power of creativity.![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmYDNtMCWdgK6jwd47ug5WPGLP6Jb13zTWmHwkau3au83i)

proposals.content:
The _Lil Nouns Interactive Activity Book_ is a creative and playful project designed to bring the world of Lil Nouns closer to children, families, and collectors. With an educational and artistic focus, the book offers a space for fun, imagination, and shared creativity, using the iconic style and values of the Lil Nouns collection.

This 15-page book will include a variety of engaging activities such as mazes, connect-the-dots, spot-the-difference games, and coloring pages, all illustrated by me and inspired by real and custom Lil Nouns. It will also feature a designed cover and back cover, completing a beautiful and cohesive piece of nounish content.

Each page is crafted to encourage interaction, storytelling, and co-creation — making the book a perfect tool for bonding between parents and children, while also serving as a fun and accessible introduction to Web3 culture.

📚 What’s Inside?

The book will include:

- **Connect the Dots** pages where kids reveal Lil Noun characters
- **Coloring Pages** with fun scenes like skating, flying, or adventuring
- **Mazes & Puzzles** that encourage logic and visual thinking
- **Design Your Own Lil Noun** templates for creative expression
- **Spot the Difference** pages that train observation and attention to detail

All activities are designed to be easily printed and used at home or during Lil Nouns community gatherings.

### 📦 Format & Accessibility

- **Digital PDF format**
- **Printable from anywhere** (home, schools, or events)
- **Optional NFT version** for on-chain distribution and collectibles
- **Language:** Bilingual (English and Spanish)

**TL;DR:**
Creative Alchemy a collective by and for African creatives is producing a Lil Nouns-themed cypher. The track, deeply rooted in African rhythms and Nounish values, will be minted, documented, and shared across platforms with lil nouns inspired cover art. Funding supports production, logistics, and fair artist compensation.

### What We’re Creating

We’re bringing together musicians from the Creative Alchemy community to write and record a **Lil Nouns cypher** that reflects the culture and energy of Africa through music. The project includes:

- **Original verses** inspired by Lil Nouns identity and values
- **Afro-influenced production**, mixing, and mastering
- **Behind-the-scenes content** from recording sessions
- **Minting the track** as a collectible (music NFT)
- **Publishing on social media** (TikTok, IG, X, etc.) to amplify the drop
- **All contents** shared including cover art design will be Lil Nouns inspired

### How It Helps Spread Lil Nouns

- Introduces Lil Nouns to **new creative communities and artists' audience in Africa** through music
- Uses **storytelling, art and rhythm** to make Nounish culture more relatable and viral
- Builds on the success of our **Nounish meetups and activations** across the continent
- Creates **evergreen nounish content** that lives onchain and offchain, inspiring others to build

### What We’ll Use Funding For

- Studio recording sessions
- Mixing, mastering & production fees
- Logistics: transportation, food, space rentals
- BTS filming and editing
- Cover art design commission
- Remaining funds shared among participating artists as support for their craft

### Examples of Past Work

- Hosted **Nounish meetups in Africa** to onboard creatives into the ecosystem
- Created **NFT music projects, open mics and live showcases** via Creative Alchemy
- Built a growing community of **cross-disciplinary African artists** using Web3 tools
- Collaborated with platforms and DAOs to spotlight Afro-creative excellence

# Art Workshop: Painting the Meme for All to See

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmdLgXggLNZH2kbGTUvQdxo4FnvDkoq9iRGh89WM13ni3K)

## Proposal

An art workshop for children aged 7 to 12 to paint their own versions of Lil Nouns on personalized canvases. 

The activity also introduces the Lil Nouns community to parents, families, and local residents, bringing everyone closer to Nounish culture in a fun and creative way. Taking place in a welcoming, open space, the workshop invites passersby to watch the action and feel curious about what’s happening.

Place: Búzios - Brazil, surrounded by nature. 

## How the children will be selected

Spots are limited and participants will be selected through an online registration form.

## How the workshop works

- Each child receives: 

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmSHSECk6qYEutq2EUkgAsquwyiPfGS62YoFB58DSrB2d7)

- The experience includes a snack break for the kids.

- At the end, each child takes everything home, their artwork, easel, canvas, apron, remaining materials and their Lil Nouns Artist Certificate.  

## How this idea helps spread the Lil Nouns meme

- Brings Lil Nouns into the real world by engaging kids and families in a playful, offline art experience.

- Taking place in a welcoming, open space, the workshop invites everyone nearby to pause and engage with the creative process.

- In a small town like Búzios, events like this tend to stand out,  making the workshop a natural topic of conversation among locals.

- Creates shareable photos and artworks to boost visibility on X and Farcaster, all documented online for the Lil Nouns community to see, enjoy and share.

- Activates local networks and expands reach beyond the crypto-native audience.

## After the workshop

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmbFJJQxgDDLqpXGC54xfssGRcy2vsoaUQd99C6t3dqTa9)

## Budget

0.3 ETH - Medium workshop (around 15+ kids) 

0.2 ETH - Small workshop (around 10+ kids)

proposals.content:
Overview:  

**FOUNS (Lil Nouns Feeder) **is an initiative to spread and deploy street feeders for stray animals, blending public art with community engagement. Utilizing recycled plastic, and **we aim to have a final 3D design **in two sizes:

- Small: Suitable for cats and small dogs.  

- Large: Designed for larger dogs and covered public spaces.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmTZr4Fz8bDWr9QgKTfCyHj12MFbxPb5vKy1E8wF1xXNMX)

The mold probably will be made by **@Fattybuthappy and other members of nouns ecossystem** in **open source format** and will enable us to produce feeder units cheaply and sustainably. With it, we can test real-world acceptance in different communities before seeking a larger expansion.

**Every piece is unique** because of recycled plastic blend in each part of world bringuing a **unique art piece** in **every **instalation.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmaULo5d8T8Nm9jgn87uCE8g3ybFZk8reGAicURCS2So8e)

---

Phase 1: Design Development

Community Collaboration:  

- @Bigshot Klim and @fattybuthappy were invited to create a prototype design based on our existing concept.  

- Present both designs for community voting to select the preferred model.

---

Phase 2: Prototyping

Dual Fabrication:

- Partner with two professionals to produce prototypes using recycled plastic.

Evaluation:

- Assess prototypes for durability, aesthetics, and cost-effectiveness.  

- Share findings with the community.

---

 Phase 3: Community Engagement

QR Code: 

Each FOUNS unit will feature a QR code linking to educational content about animal welfare and the Nouns ecosystem.

Global Outreach:

Establish partnerships with animal welfare advocates and organizations worldwide to promote the initiative.

---

## Sustainability and Reinvestment

Unused Funds:  

Any remaining funds will be allocated to purchase Lil Nouns tokens, reinvesting in the community that supports this project.

---

## Invitation 💛

**Anyone** who wants to be part of the FOUNS movement — as a local representative, global partner, or creative collaborator blending ideas and formats — **is warmly invited to join us**.  

You’re more than welcome here, let's do public art together with local change.

A massive cyberattack strikes the global blockchain system.

Billions of Lil Nouns NFTs are forcibly released from their smart contracts…

And they become real.

No longer confined to the digital realm, the Lil Nouns now roam the physical world—wild, untamed, and without conscience.

It was as if prisoners had escaped their digital cells.

Humanity wasn’t prepared.

World War III erupts.

Nations fall.

Civilization collapse.

But in the ruins of a broken world… a spark of hope appears.

A nameless young man, with no past and no identity…

Possesses one simple desire: to travel the world.

From his first step, a grand adventure begins.

He will encounter Lil Nouns with a trace of consciousness.

He will witness the remnants of a once-great civilization.

And maybe—just maybe—he will uncover the truth behind it all.

This project is specifically designed to spread the Lil Nouns meme in four key ways:

- **New Audiences:** The art style provides a powerful bridge to the massive **global LEGO® fan community**.
- **Community Engine:** **Open-sourcing the 3D models** empowers our community to create their own art, turning them into a decentralized engine for proliferation.
- **Permanent Hub:** The OnCyber world will be a **permanent, on-chain clubhouse**, accessible to anyone with just a browser.

I'm proposing to create a **bilingual illustrated fanzine** — designed to introduce new audiences to Lil Nouns, its governance model, and the kinds of ideas it supports.

The fanzine will exist in two versions:

- A **Spanish version**, screen-printed in silkscreen on heavyweight paper, folded into a compact booklet with **8 internal pages** and a **large full-page poster illustration on the back**.
- An **English version**, distributed digitally for download and sharing.

The content will include:

- What Lil Nouns is and how it works
- How to participate in governance
- Examples of funded proposals
- Links and QR codes to join the community

All of it will be **fully illustrated by me**
**You can check most of my work here: **[**https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVO07raP0=/**](https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVO07raP0=/)

### 🎯 Why this matters

Lil Nouns has global potential, but most of its material is in English and limited to online spaces. This project brings Lil Nouns **offline**, into physical spaces and new communities — especially Spanish-speaking creatives who might never encounter Lil Nouns otherwise.

The fanzines will be **distributed for free** at IRL events, creative spaces, sticker shops, zine libraries, and directly on the street. No gatekeeping, no paywalls — just an invitation to explore and participate.

### 🛠️ Timeline (3 months total)

- **Phase 1 – Research & writing**: gather references from the community, write and structure the content
- **Phase 2 – Design & illustration**: develop the visual identity and layout
- **Phase 3 – Feedback & refinement**: share a draft with the Lil community and apply feedback
- **Phase 4 – Production & distribution**: screen printing, assembling sticker packs, and handing them out IRL

proposals.tldr: All I really want is to keep creating pixels — freely, and without pressure. I’ve always enjoyed mixing themes, jumping from one idea to another, and letting inspiration guide me without overthinking it. That’s how I’ve built my little…
proposals.content:
All I really want is to keep creating pixels — freely, and without pressure.

I’ve always enjoyed mixing themes, jumping from one idea to another, and letting inspiration guide me without overthinking it. That’s how I’ve built my little pixel world, and I’d love to keep doing that for as long as I can.

Over time, I’ve ended up creating several pieces around the **Nouns** theme. It wasn’t something planned — it just happened naturally, because I enjoy the energy and playfulness around the ecosystem.

And honestly? Why stop now? If something inspires you and you’re having fun, that should be reason enough to keep going.

I know we often tie everything to a purpose — a collection, a sale, a campaign, a deadline. But for me, there’s something really powerful about making art simply _for the joy of creating it_. No strategy, no roadmap, just vibes and pixels.

That’s the kind of spirit I think we need to keep alive in web3.

Because at the end of the day, this space was built by people playing, experimenting, pushing buttons to see what happens — and I don’t want to lose that.

Art without a fixed purpose is not a waste — it’s the foundation for discovery.

Most of my favorite pieces didn’t come from planning. They came from sitting down, opening Aseprite, and messing around with an idea just because it _felt_ fun.

So yeah — I’ll keep creating, I’ll keep mixing styles and themes like I’ve done so far, and if something good comes out of it, amazing. If not, at least I had a good time doing it.

Sometimes the best projects are born from the moments where you’re not trying to make anything at all —

just having fun with your craft.

And I think that’s something worth protecting.

Also, shoutout to **1337** — my main source of motivation and inspiration.

Everything I’ve learned, every step I’ve taken, has been shaped by that world.

And no matter where I go or what I draw, a part of 1337 is always with me in every pixel.

GM Lil Nouners, I'm pixelsbykay, a 3D Artist and Animator from South Africa. I'm no stranger to the Nouns and the impact it has had, not only on the Web3 community but to myself as an artist having created short form content centred around the Nouns brand.

# My Proposal

I propose creating a two minute animated short film centred around the Lil Nouns characters. The film would bring Lil Nouns characters to life by putting story, personality, experiences and little idiosyncrancies behind each Lil Noun character included in the film. The short film will be humourous, cute, adventurous, exciting and everything else we've come to love about the Lil Nouns and their adventures.

# Why Vote For Me? - Proliferating Lil Nouns

The Nouns ecosystem has mass appeal, the characters attract both, the young audience and the old, with each piece of content around the Nouns generating millions of views online.

The Lil Nouns short film would serve as an addition to the already viral Nouns content that lives online by being distributed through various social media platforms such as Instagram, X and Youtube. Moments from the film would also be edited and converted to .gif format files and uploaded to GIPHY, tenor and Imgur.

In addition to online audiences, the film would be submitted to submission fee free Short Animation Film Festivals around the world, further proliferating Lil Nouns and the Nouns ecosystem amongst demographics that are not Web3 or social media savvy.

The film would also serve as a source of entertainment for all Nouners gathering at any Nouns IRL events around the world.

### Project Concept

**Lil Vibes on Campus** is a high-energy, music-filled event hosted at a Nigerian university, designed to merge **youth culture, creativity, and web3**. Inspired by the Lil Nouns ethos, this event features live music, interactive activities, and visual storytelling to introduce students to the world of DAOs, NFTs, and digital communities—in a fun, accessible way.

###  Event Highlights

- **Live Student Performances**: Campus musicians and DJs perform original tracks and Nounish-themed freestyles.
- **Custom Pixel Art Booth**: “Create Your Lil Noun” – Students generate their own pixel avatars, share them on social, or mint them as collectibles.
- **Trivia + Game Corner**: Learn about DAOs and NFTs through fun challenges, with winners earning branded swag or POAPs.
- **Art & Installations**: Lil Nouns-themed banners, posters, and visuals light up the stage and venue.

### Additional Features

- **POAPs (Proof of Attendance Protocols)**: Everyone who attends gets a digital collectible badge proving they were part of the movement.
- **Live Twitter/X Coverage**: Highlights, freestyles, and Lil Nouns content are shared online in real-time.
- **Media Recap**: Photos and videos from the event will be shared with the DAO and broader community as public content.

###  Goals

- Spread the **Lil Nouns philosophy** of fun, freedom, and creative ownership.
- Introduce **university students** to DAOs and web3 through music and culture.
- Amplify local voices by spotlighting **student talent**.
- Make Lil Nouns feel like a **real-world brand**, not just a digital one.

proposals.content:
**Overview:**
What happens when the meme breaks? I’ll create three large-scale, high-detail glitch art pieces using my custom tools—like _Bucket Bender_ and _Huemancer_—to mutate Lil Nouns into warped, radiant icons. Each piece will distort and remix core Lil Nouns symbols through my signature process of controlled visual degradation, chromatic violence, and emergent error.

**My Background:**
I’m Dawnia Darkstone (aka _Letsglitchit_), a glitch artist and circuitbender with 11 years of practice warping reality one pixel at a time. My work has been auctioned by Sotheby’s and Christie’s, exhibited in Times Square, VICE, and galleries worldwide. I create custom web apps to bend visual inputs into glitch-driven, emotionally resonant chaos.

**What I’ll Create:**

- **3 standalone glitch artworks**, each reimagining Lil Nouns iconography through mutation, distortion, and color logic collapse.
- **Each piece will be uniquely generated** using tools I’ve coded myself, offering aesthetic results that couldn’t be made any other way.
- Final output will be digital-first, in both looping video and high-resolution still formats for maximum shareability.

**How This Spreads the Meme:**
Lil Nouns are already memetic—but glitches propagate like viruses. These works turn Lil Nouns into image-events: arresting, shareable, and strange enough to draw attention even outside Web3. They’ll live on social, but also in pop-up projections, screensavers, and generative remix sessions.

**Timeline (3 Months):**

- **Month 1:** Develop thematic sketches + refine Lil Nouns source fragments
- **Month 2:** Run multiple generative glitch passes, curate top mutations
- **Month 3:** Finalize visuals + share them across platforms (Twitter, Farcaster, Instagram, TikTok glitch art niches)

proposals.content:
“Sounds of the Nouniverse” is a 3-day immersive music production summer camp led by NUELZO — a Nigerian music producer and artist with over 8 years of experience and 1.8M+ streams across platforms. Set to take place in Makurdi, Benue State, Nigeria, the camp targets young and emerging music creatives in West Africa.

The goal is to teach participants essential skills in music production, mixing, mastering, and collaborative songwriting, while also introducing them to the Nouns and Lil Nouns communities, their values, and the concept of decentralized, community-driven creation.

A key outcome of the camp is the creation of a collaborative “Lil Nouns Anthem” — a high-quality song celebrating the Nouns spirit. The project also includes the release of a short documentary, educational resources, and the minting of the final track as an NFT.

The initiative aims to empower youth, foster creativity, and onboard new members into the Web3 space through the universal language of music.

Budget request: 0.5 ETH (~$1,250) to cover equipment, instructor fees, venue, meals, merchandise, and documentation.

Deliverables include:

🎵 A fully produced Lil Nouns Anthem

🎥 A short documentary

📁 Educational materials

🖼️ NFT release of the anthem

🌐 Public on-chain launch

🌱 A stronger Lil Nouns presence in Africa

This project amplifies Lil Nouns’ global reach by cultivating new talent, encouraging decentralized creativity, and planting cultural roots in a vibrant, fast-growing creative ecosystem.

proposals.content:
My name is **Moses Fwangte Joshua**, a 37-year-old father of three beautiful girls. **Ryajala** will turn 11 this year; we began this journey when she was just 7. Her younger sisters, **Hummat** and **Leticia**, are currently 7 and 3 years old, respectively.

With a background in education, I served as the head of a school in Pankshin, Plateau State, Nigeria. I began supporting my students with sanitary pads as far back as 2012, after discovering that some missed school or used rags during their menstrual cycles due to lack of access to proper sanitary products.

Fast forward to 2021, when we joined the Web3 space—_we launched a 1k NFT collection, which enabled us to provide 1,100 girls with free sanitary pads._ Since then, having built a name and reputation for ourselves, we’ve been able to help:

**2,900 girls with free sanitary pads,**
**600+ kids and orphans with clothes and shoes,**
**Nearly 4,000 children with school supplies,**
**A blind school with food items,**
**And we’ve visited every orphanage within our state capital.**
We are **registered** with the Nigerian government, and we have **purchased a piece of land**, where we plan to build a **vocational centre for long-term impact. **

The collage drawings uploaded show samples of the Gen 1 art created by the girls. Our Gen 2 art is even more vibrant and appealing, reflecting how much the girls have grown in wisdom, creativity, and skill.

If given the opportunity, we plan to provide another **2,000 girls with free sanitary pads**. Our long-term goal is not just to give handouts, but to empower these children through education and skills. The land is ready, and we’ve already paid for the building plan. **Our next step is to lay the foundation for the first classroom of our vocational centre.**

This initiative will surely spread awareness of Lil Nouns, as **all credit goes to them for sponsoring both the sanitary pad and the planned foundation work.** We also ensure transparency by streaming all our events live via Google Meet, so anyone anywhere can witness the impact. proposals.content:
### 🧠 What’s the idea?

We’ll create a large Lil Nouns mural at our **Nounish Art School in Peru**, with a twist:  

**It will be painted by kids**—students from our school and children from the local community.  

The design, created by our team’s artist **Claudio**, will be a black-and-white Lil Nounish illustration, ready for the kids to color in.  

The mural will also exist **1:1 as an NFT** on **Zora**, with a **QR code and URL** placed next to it on the wall.

This is more than just a mural—it’s a **living, participatory work of art** that brings Lil Nouns into the real world, celebrates creativity, and introduces kids to web3 in the most joyful, innocent way.

---

### 🖼️ What we’ll do with the funding:

- Host an **Open Paint Day** for kids (target: 20+ participants)  

- Give each kid a **certificate of participation + fun Nounish gifts**  

- **Mint the mural as a 1/1 NFT on Zora**, and install a **QR code** linking to it next to the wall  

- **Print and distribute stickers** linked to the mural/NFT  

- **Include a community feedback round** before executing the mural (we’re open to input from Lil Nouns holders and artists!)

---

### 📌 Why it matters

- **Fun, bold, and wholesome** → kids + murals + NFTs = 📸🔥

- **Expands the Lil Nouns world**   

- **It’s a physical NFT** → visible in real life, immortalized on-chain

---

### 🧰 What we’ve done before

We run the **Nounish Art School IRL** in Trujillo, Peru, proudly funded by Nouns DAO.  

Here’s what we’ve built so far:

- Founded Nounish Art School 

- Painted **collaborative murals** with local artists and students  

- Hosted **web3 art workshops** for underserved youth  

- Organized the **Global Pizza Party** 

- Built an mini app on farcaster for onboarding emerging artist to web 3 

### 📅 Timeline

- **Month 1:** Community call + mural prep  

- **Month 2:** Paint Day! + NFT minting on Zora  

- **Month 3:** Sticker drop + content recap (photos/video)
